title: Finishing Pages, step 2 — choosing a computer file from your phone

steps.path: A page used from your phone's browser → its 'Open a file' button
steps.headline: From your phone's browser, 'Open a file' shows YouCoded's own chooser over your computer's folders.
steps.changed: 'Choose a file', with '<page> asks for a file on your computer.' under it. One card labelled 'Your computer': where you are (Home › Documents › …) as buttons you can go back to, then the folders and files there.
steps.notice: It starts at your computer's home folder. Password and key files never appear, and nothing outside your home folder can be reached.
steps.risk: Your computer's folder names show on the phone while you browse.

steps.path: The chooser inside a folder, with a file chosen
steps.headline: Only the kinds of file the page works with are listed; the rest are counted, and the chosen file is highlighted.
steps.changed: Inside Documents › Budgets, the Budget page sees its .xlsx and .csv files, a line saying '1 other file is not shown', and Budget 2026.xlsx chosen. Open is filled; Cancel outlined beside it.
steps.notice: Open stays grey until a file is chosen (pointing at it says so). A double tap on a file opens it straight away.

steps.path: A page saving a new file, from your phone's browser
steps.headline: Saving works the same way: choose a folder on your computer, name the file, Save here.
steps.changed: 'Save a file' — '<page> wants to save a file on your computer.' The same folder card, then 'Save as' with the file name box, the page's suggested name filled in.
steps.notice: Tapping an existing file puts its name in the box; saving over it will ask first.
steps.risk: A name the computer cannot use (a slash, for example) is refused with a plain sentence when you press Save here.

steps.headline: At phone size the buttons stack, Open on top, and file sizes drop to keep names readable.
steps.changed: Same chooser, full width; Open over Cancel.
steps.notice: Long folder paths scroll sideways instead of wrapping.
